name: openoutreach_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the openoutreach capability.

prompts.name: lead_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Describe your product or service to generate a list of ideal B2B leads: {product_description}
prompts.use_case: Automating discovery and outreach to potential B2B customers.

prompts.name: lead_explanation_prompt
prompts.template: Explain why this individual is a good lead for the product described: {lead_profile}
prompts.use_case: Generating transparent lead lists with rationale for marketing teams.

prompts.name: email_composition_prompt
prompts.template: Compose a personalized outreach email for this lead based on the product: {lead_profile}, {product_description}
prompts.use_case: Integrating personalized cold email campaigns into sales workflows.
